title: Enterprise Actor Schema
description: Canonical representation of an actor participating in an enterprise business process.

actor_description.description: Additional description of the actor's purpose or responsibilities.

department.description: Department to which the actor belongs.

role.description: Business role performed by the actor.

email.description: Contact email address of the actor.

organisation.description: Organization or external company associated with the actor.

responsibilities.description: Primary responsibilities performed by the actor.

systems_used.description: Systems typically used by the actor while executing the process.

is_process_owner.description: Indicates whether the actor owns the overall business process.
